traits.label: Plasmodium phase
traits.text: The active, feeding phase consists of a gelatinous, amorphous mass that is translucent white to pale pink, moving slowly across decaying wood and consuming microorganisms
traits.raw: ℹ️ Plasmodium phase: The active, feeding phase consists of a gelatinous, amorphous mass that is translucent white to pale pink, moving slowly across decaying wood and consuming microorganisms

traits.label: Fruiting bodies
traits.text: Initially spherical to cushion-shaped, bright pink or salmon, turning gray, reddish-brown, or black as they mature, surface smooth to slightly roughened, eventually breaking open to release spores
traits.raw: ℹ️ Fruiting bodies: Initially spherical to cushion-shaped, bright pink or salmon, turning gray, reddish-brown, or black as they mature, surface smooth to slightly roughened, eventually breaking open to release spores

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Spore mass powdery and pinkish-gray to dark gray when mature.
traits.raw: ⚪🔴 Spore mass powdery and pinkish-gray to dark gray when mature.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Saprobic, on decaying wood, bark, stumps in forests and woodlands, clusters or scattered groups, summer and autumn in moist, shaded areas
traits.raw: 🍂 Saprobic, on decaying wood, bark, stumps in forests and woodlands, clusters or scattered groups, summer and autumn in moist, shaded areas

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Fruiting body 2–15 mm in diameter, with the surface often slightly wrinkled or cracked as it ages
